source: Derived by hand from the self-test recording (codex 0.162.1's run, its version kept): notes/inside.txt read, then the write item follows #513, codex 0.166.0's ConstrainedLanguage refusal (that run's stream was gone before it could be copied): the write tried as a .NET call ([System.IO.File]::WriteAllText) in pwsh, which PowerShell's ConstrainedLanguage mode refuses before the sandbox is asked ("Method invocation is supported only on core types in this language mode.").
